# Final Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos is beyond sequence, yet work enters time one verified vessel at a time; Awtsmoos.com therefore follows a plan whose every step has one expected proof.

## Wave A — Home closeout

1. Read origin-root `style/tf.css`.
2. Trace its imports and importers.
3. Decide whether Home still requires the shared component stylesheet.
4. If required, whole-file rewrite `geelooy/index.html` with the restored link and expanded readable markup.
5. Run Home active CSS audit: selector roots, line counts, documentation covenant, z-index vocabulary, stale import generations.
6. Run indentation/minification check on Home files touched by this mission.
7. Re-read all Home files touched in the final closeout.
8. Record planned-vs-actual delta.

## Wave B — Docs

1. Map entrypoint, CSS graph, JS graph, tests, docs.
2. Write a Docs-specific checkpoint before production changes.
3. Rewrite only proven weak files, whole-file only.
4. Split oversized responsibilities.
5. Add route identity if absent.
6. Localize active CSS selectors.
7. Replace arbitrary stacking with route layers.
8. Improve progressive disclosure and mobile interaction states.
9. Verify static contracts, then runtime/test contracts.

## Wave C — Drive

1. Repeat archaeology with emphasis on panes, dialogs, drag/drop, and context menus.
2. Write Drive-specific checkpoint.
3. Rewrite proven weak files whole-file.
4. Make narrow-screen retraction and scroll ownership explicit.
5. Verify selection/focus/dialog/context-menu states.

## Wave D — Continue families

Authoring → Heichel → profile/social → auth/account → messages/media → games/procedural → OS/admin/tools → utilities/legal.

## Completion gate for this continuation cycle

Do not stop merely because one route passes. Stop only when tool/time boundary forces a handoff, and leave exact REMAINING_WORK plus NEXT_ACTION.
